methodology.cohortDisplayNote: Certification year is first observed certification; size is the most recent assessment available in the snapshot, not historical size at certification.
displayGroups: Documented not small, likely not small, or unknown
methodology.displayDenominator: All eligible records, including unknowns. Two groups are exhaustive and sum to 100%; underlying evidence tiers remain available for audit.
methodology.providerUnit: Resolved legal/provider identities; aliases merged, subsidiaries not automatically merged into parents.
methodology.offeringUnit: FedRAMP package ID; separate packages can represent the same software at different classes.
methodology.historicalProviderRule: Earliest first-certification event within each cohort; no current-size backdating.
methodology.unknownHandling: Unknowns stay in denominators; unidentified products remain in offering totals and are excluded from provider totals with explicit coverage counts.
methodology.secRule: Annual revenue facts filed before the assessment date; nonoverlapping annual periods in preceding five years, sum divided by five exceeds $47m; likely-not-small only.
methodology.registryRule: Active matched SBA profile: primary cloud-related NAICS if present; otherwise all registered cloud-related NAICS must be reported small. No inference of large size from absent records.
methodology.sourceHistory: Marketplace Git history begins April 14, 2026; earlier status events are retrospective records. Historical identities and small-business history remain incomplete.
